summary: CBRE Group filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary CBRE Services completed a $1.0B senior notes offering: $500M of 5.650% notes due 2032 and $500M of 5.900% notes due 2037, both fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the parent. Notes were sold under an October 27, 2026 underwriting agreement with Wells Fargo, BofA, HSBC and J.P. Morgan, issued off an existing Form S-3 shelf via supplemental indentures. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes, commercial paper repayment, and the pending Onnec Group Limited acquisition. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch the Onnec closing.
